selection.public: All 5–300 second public page samples; full recordings, hash order
selection.fresh: 16 public voice IDs absent from prior corpus plans/results, 20 authored utterances; four matched sonic-3.5 controls

measurement.order: All originals in frozen order, then all processed outputs. Fixed original sentinels rechecked during the processed phase to detect service drift.

execution_notes.reason: Prioritize all native processed outputs for earlier failure diagnosis while retaining every planned recording and the fixed candidate.
Yield between requests so queued development clients can use the shared serialized detector; global minimum spacing and case set unchanged.

asr.method: Native long-form timestamp decoding; no artificial segment word cuts
asr.known_language: Fresh requests and explicit public language metadata; otherwise original automatic detection, reused for output
asr.normalization: Whisper BasicTextNormalizer(remove_diacritics=False), NFKC; Chinese/Japanese CER, otherwise whitespace WER
asr.limitation: Recognizer output is an estimate; paired disagreements do not prove changed speech or unchanged speech.
asr.padding_policy: Waveform padded to at least 30 seconds at 16kHz; complete longer audio untruncated; attention mask supplied

speaker.limitation: Descriptive embedding cosine; no calibrated speaker identity or listening guarantee

secondary_asr.known_language: Fresh requests and explicit public language metadata; otherwise original automatic detection, reused for output
secondary_asr.normalization: Whisper BasicTextNormalizer(remove_diacritics=False), NFKC; Chinese/Japanese CER, otherwise whitespace WER
secondary_asr.limitation: Recognizer output is an estimate; paired disagreements do not prove changed speech or unchanged speech.
secondary_asr.padding_policy: Waveform padded to at least 30 seconds at 16kHz; complete longer audio untruncated; attention mask supplied

interpretation: Observed complete-file endpoint responses for this frozen candidate. Originally negative recordings do not count as removals. Sentinels are repeated controls, not new samples. No universal success, physical erasure, or human-rated speech fidelity claim.

verification_cli_smoke.interpretation: Integration smoke test on a spent generated fixture; excluded from held-out and removal denominators.

execution_notes.reason: Yield between requests to queued clients. Frozen targets, candidate, spacing and HTTP cap unchanged.

repeat_stability.interpretation: Repeated exact-file responses are not additional independent recordings. Private development inputs and their individual fingerprints remain local.

long_study.correlation_note: long_04 extends long_00 text and shares the familiar English voice; long_03 is the paired unmarked control. Not five independent voices.

execution_notes.reason: Yield queued clients between requests; changed before the first long measurement. Candidate, order, spacing and cap unchanged.

evaluation_corrections.scope: ASR evaluation only; frozen candidate and endpoint measurements unchanged
evaluation_corrections.bug: Short automatic-language input had 1515 mel frames; Whisper encoder requires 3000.
evaluation_corrections.correction: Pad the ASR waveform to at least 30 seconds, preserving full longer input and its attention mask.
evaluation_corrections.cache_policy: Reuse an old transcript only after exact equality of every old/new feature tensor and attention mask. Otherwise rerun inference.
